basic_details.job_title: ARI Research Student Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Biodiversity & Palaeobiology (Plant & Diatoms) Group of MACS - Agharkar Research Institute (ARI), Pune, an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, has invited online applications for 1 temporary Research Student post under the MGB (Maharashtra Gene Bank, Nagpur) sponsored project SP-371. The essential qualification is First Class in M.Sc. Botany, the fixed monthly stipend is Rs.28000/-, and applications are accepted at http://aripune.res.in from 09.11.2026 to 20.11.2026.

important_dates.interview_date: To be displayed on the Institute website

how_to_apply: Open the online application link http://aripune.res.in and apply on or before 20.11.2026 (applications began on 09.11.2026).
Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned in the Essential Qualification.
Attach a recent passport size photograph.
Reserved category candidates attach a caste certificate issued by the competent authority.

Pay the non-refundable fee of ₹100/- online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/ (steps printed: Educational Institutions → Categogy → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee → enter necessary fields / details).
Attach the receipt of online payment of the fee and write the online receipt number in the application form. SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates are excepted from the fee.
The Institute is not responsible for any incomplete, pending or failed transactions of online fee payments; candidates may contact the concerned bank in this regard.
important_instructions: No T.A. is admissible for interviews. Selected candidates will have no right for appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post. The fee is non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: ARI Research Student at a Glance

rows.details: MACS - Agharkar Research Institute (An Autonomous Institute under Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India)

Investingating the Diversity, Distribution and Traditional Knowledge of Medicinal Plant Species in the Northern Sahyadri region (Nashik, Dhule and Nandurbar districts) of the Western Ghats, Maharashtra
Project period up to 26.03.2028; the position is purely on contractual basis
Research Student (temporary post); Post Code: MGB-19-SP371-2026-27
30 Years as on closing date of advt.

content_sections.heading: About ARI
content_sections.text: MACS - Agharkar Research Institute is an autonomous institute under the Department of Science & Technology, Govt. of India, located at G. G. Agarkar Road, Pune 411 004. This post sits in its Biodiversity & Palaeobiology (Plant & Diatoms) Group. The project co-ordinator / Principal Investigator is Dr. M.N. Datar, Scientist E.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice does not give a category-wise break-up of the single post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Desirable qualifications: Specialization in plant identification. Experience of field work in Western Ghats, herbarium preparation, QGIS and Species Distribution Modelling. Age limit: 30 Years as on closing date of advt. Relaxation will be applicable for the OBC, SC, ST etc. categories according to Govt of India regulations. The prescribed essential qualifications are minimum, and possession of them alone does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview. In the case of deserving and exceptionally qualified candidates, desirable qualifications are relaxed at the discretion of the Competent Authority. Whether a qualification is equivalent to the essential and desirable qualifications is decided at the discretion of the relevant committee constituted for scrutinizing the applications. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The monthly stipend is Rs.28000/- (Fixed). The project period runs up to 26.03.2028. The position is purely on contractual basis, and the selected candidate may be assigned to another project based on Institutional requirement. Selected candidates will have no right for appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ARI Research Student
content_sections.text: Open the online application link http://aripune.res.in and apply on or before 20.11.2026 (applications began on 09.11.2026). Attach self-attested scanned certificates as mentioned in the Essential Qualification. Attach a recent passport size photograph. Reserved category candidates attach a caste certificate issued by the competent authority. Pay the non-refundable fee of ₹100/- online through https://www.onlinesbi.sbi/sbicollect/ (steps printed: Educational Institutions → Categogy → Agharkar Research Institute-MACS → Payment Category → Application Fee → enter necessary fields / details). Attach the receipt of online payment of the fee and write the online receipt number in the application form. SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates are excepted from the fee. The Institute is not responsible for any incomplete, pending or failed transactions of online fee payments; candidates may contact the concerned bank in this regard.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The shortlist of candidates for the online interview, and the day, date and time of the interview, will be displayed on the Institute website. Candidates have the option to appear for the interview in Hindi language as well.

faq.question: Q1. How many Research Student posts has ARI advertised?
faq.answer: ARI has advertised 1 temporary Research Student post under the MGB (Maharashtra Gene Bank, Nagpur) sponsored project SP-371.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ARI Research Student post?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application is 20.11.2026. Applications opened on 09.11.2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for ARI Research Student?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is First Class in M.Sc. Botany. Specialization in plant identification and experience of field work in Western Ghats, herbarium preparation, QGIS and Species Distribution Modelling are desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ARI Research Student post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 30 Years as on closing date of advt. Relaxation applies for OBC, SC, ST etc. categories according to Govt of India regulations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the stipend for ARI Research Student?
faq.answer: The monthly stipend is Rs.28000/- (Fixed).

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee, and who is exempt?
faq.answer: The non-refundable application fee is ₹100/-. SC/ST/Divyang/Women candidates are excepted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the ARI Research Student post?
faq.answer: Apply online at http://arijob.ourlib.in on or before 20.11.2026, attaching self-attested scanned certificates, a recent passport size photograph, a caste certificate for reserved category and the fee receipt if applicable.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are selected through an online interview. If many applications are received, the Institute may shortlist candidates for the interview, and the shortlist and interview schedule will be displayed on the Institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ARI Research Student post permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is a temporary post, purely on contractual basis, under a project running up to 26.03.2028. Selected candidates may be assigned to another project and have no right for appointment against any ARI or funding agency's post.

faq.question: Q10. Is travel allowance paid for the interview, and can it be given in Hindi?
faq.answer: No T.A. is admissible for interviews. Candidates have the option to appear for the interview in Hindi language as well.
